name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
name_es: 988 Línea de Prevención del Suicidio y Crisis
description: Free, confidential support 24/7 for anyone in emotional distress, a mental health or substance use crisis, or thinking about suicide. Call, text or chat.
description_es: Apoyo gratuito y confidencial 24/7 para cualquier persona en crisis emocional, de salud mental o de consumo de sustancias, o que piensa en el suicidio. Llama, envía un mensaje o chatea.
how: Call or text 988. Spanish: press 2, or text AYUDA to 988. Veterans: press 1.
how_es: Llama o envía un mensaje al 988. Español: oprime 2, o envía AYUDA al 988. Veteranos: oprime 1.
keywords: suicide suicidal kill myself want to die end my life don't want to be here hopeless can't go on self harm cutting hurt myself crisis panic overwhelmed depressed manic not sleeping racing thoughts worried about a friend suicidio quiero morir no quiero vivir hacerme daño crisis deprimido

name: 911 Emergency
description: Immediate danger, a medical emergency, or a possible overdose. Call now.
description_es: Peligro inmediato, una emergencia médica o una posible sobredosis. Llama ahora.
keywords: emergency danger unsafe right now overdose took too many pills can't breathe seizure fainted ambulance emergencia peligro sobredosis

name: Poison Control
description: Took too much medication, the wrong medication, or mixed something? Experts answer 24/7, free. If they're not breathing or won't wake up, call 911.
description_es: ¿Tomaste demasiado medicamento, el medicamento equivocado o mezclaste algo? Expertos responden 24/7, gratis. Si no respira o no despierta, llama al 911.
keywords: overdose took too many pills double dose wrong medication mixed meds alcohol and pills poison sobredosis demasiadas pastillas

name: Crisis Text Line
description: Free 24/7 support by text with a trained crisis counselor, for any kind of crisis. Good if talking out loud feels like too much.
description_es: Apoyo gratuito 24/7 por mensaje de texto con un consejero de crisis capacitado.
keywords: text don't want to talk can't talk out loud texting anxious lonely stressed overwhelmed panic attack mensaje de texto

name: The Trevor Project
description: 24/7 crisis support for LGBTQ+ young people under 25, by phone, text or chat.
description_es: Apoyo en crisis 24/7 para jóvenes LGBTQ+ menores de 25 años, por teléfono, mensaje o chat.
how_es: Llama al 1-866-488-7386 o envía START al 678-678.
keywords: lgbtq lgbt gay lesbian bi bisexual trans transgender queer nonbinary coming out identity scared family doesn't accept me

name: Emory Counseling and Psychological Services (CAPS)
name_es: Servicios de Consejería y Psicología de Emory (CAPS)
description: Free, confidential counseling for Emory students. Phone support 24/7, year-round; drop-in 8:30 to 5 on weekdays.
description_es: Consejería gratuita y confidencial para estudiantes de Emory. Apoyo telefónico 24/7 todo el año.
how: Call 404-727-7450 (after hours, press 1). 1462 Clifton Rd, Suite 235.
keywords: emory student campus counseling counselor therapist on campus college university stressed exams CAPS

name: Emory Student Intervention Services (on-call)
name_es: Servicios de Intervención Estudiantil de Emory
description: An on-call professional for Emory students in crisis after hours.
description_es: Un profesional de guardia para estudiantes de Emory en crisis fuera de horario.
keywords: emory student after hours on call crisis night weekend

name: Emory Police (emergencies on campus)
name_es: Policía de Emory (emergencias en el campus)
description: For an after-hours mental health emergency on campus, the Emory Police dispatcher will help. Off campus, call 911.
description_es: Para una emergencia de salud mental en el campus fuera de horario. Fuera del campus, llama al 911.
keywords: emory campus police emergency dorm residence hall

name: Emory HelpLine (peer support)
description: Confidential peer-support phone line run by Emory students, advised by CAPS. For when you just want someone to listen.
description_es: Línea telefónica confidencial de apoyo entre compañeros de Emory.
keywords: talk to someone listen lonely peer student emory just need to vent

name: Georgia Crisis & Access Line (GCAL)
name_es: Línea de Crisis y Acceso de Georgia (GCAL)
description: Georgia's 24/7 line for mental health and substance use crises, and help getting care.
description_es: Línea de Georgia 24/7 para crisis de salud mental y consumo de sustancias.
keywords: georgia atlanta crisis substance drugs alcohol mobile crisis

name: Emory Healthcare psychiatrist on call
name_es: Psiquiatra de guardia de Emory Healthcare
description: For established Emory Healthcare patients who need a psychiatrist after hours or on weekends, for example if you ran out of medication.
description_es: Para pacientes de Emory Healthcare que necesitan un psiquiatra fuera de horario, por ejemplo si se quedaron sin medicamento.
keywords: ran out of meds out of medication refill prescription psychiatrist after hours weekend me quedé sin medicamento
